speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The loaf looks smaller than winter's. It is still a penny, and it is still a thumb short of the notch. Cut it.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Memory may. Cutting does not. I am cutting it four ways.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four ways, then. I will not tell the notch it is wrong.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Eat. The price is the price. I am not having a speech at this table about a loaf.

speaker: gillis_verbeke
text: I have said the one sentence. I will eat my quarter.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: And I have said cutting does not. The knife is down.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then the knife is down, and the penny stands.
